استضعفوا (form X)
# اِسْتَضْعَفُوا (istaḍʕafū) /is.tadˤ.ʕa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
# اُسْتُضْعِفُوا (ustuḍʕifū) /us.tudˤ.ʕi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
# اِسْتَضْعِفُوا (istaḍʕifū) /is.tadˤ.ʕi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
